channel.title: Bison Army — Field Dispatches
channel.description: Articles on discipline, calisthenics, and the Bison Army methodology.

item.title: The Power of Static Holds: Why Isometric Training Builds Strength, Stability, and Discipline
item.description: Static holds are simple, equipment-free strength training. See what isometric research says about strength, tendons, and posture, and how to start.

item.title: What Happens When You Exercise for 15 Minutes Every Day
item.description: Daily 15-minute workouts can build consistency and discipline. See what the research says about health benefits, and where 15 minutes falls short.

item.title: Why Most People Quit Their Fitness Goals
item.description: Most people don't quit because they're weak. They quit because their system is broken. Learn the psychology behind it and how to fix it.

item.title: How to Stop Starting Over Every Monday
item.description: If you restart your fitness routine every Monday, you're not alone. Learn the psychology behind the cycle and how to break it with a discipline-first approach.

item.title: How to Build Workout Discipline in 30 Days
item.description: A structured, psychology-backed 30-day plan to build workout discipline, strengthen identity, and create a consistent training routine that lasts.

item.title: Why Motivation Fails (And What Actually Builds Lasting Fitness Habits)
item.description: Motivation comes and goes. Learn why discipline and consistency build lasting fitness success, and how to create a workout routine that sticks.
